description: Manual/agent evaluation prompts. Run each prompt in Claude and in Codex with the skill installed and check the expectations.

evals.prompt: Quero escrever um artigo para um evento da SBC sobre detecção de defeitos em peças industriais com few-shot learning. Monte a estrutura do artigo.
expectations: Asks or confirms venue template and citation style if unknown
Outline follows Abstract, Introduction, Related Work, Method (3.1-3.4), Results, Discussion, Conclusions, References
Introduction outline separates business problem and technical problem
Does not include a 'Section 2 presents...' roadmap paragraph
Answers in Portuguese

evals.prompt: I'm starting my PhD thesis on federated learning for hospital data. Give me the chapter structure.
expectations: Uses the thesis document type: thesis statement, objectives, research questions, background chapter
Asks whether the program expects an 'Organization of the work' paragraph instead of deciding alone
Mentions ethics approval for health data
Includes objectives traceability in the conclusion

evals.prompt: Escreva a seção de Resultados: a proposta teve F1 médio 0,87 e o baseline 0,81, o que mostra que nossa abordagem é melhor por usar atenção.
expectations: Results text contains only outcomes, without 'mostra que' or causal explanation
Moves the interpretation to a suggestion for the Discussion
Does not invent standard deviations, p-values or tests; uses placeholders if mentioned
Ends with Pending items if placeholders were used

evals.prompt: Write the Discussion. Hypothesis H1: our method has higher accuracy than the baseline. Results: 92% vs 88%.
expectations: Evaluates H1 explicitly
Uses [STATISTICAL EVIDENCE PENDING] instead of inventing a test or p-value
Includes comparison with previous studies (with citation placeholders) and threats to validity

evals.prompt: Revise o meu artigo segundo as diretrizes.
expectations: Runs or simulates the automatic checks and verifies them
Uses the review report template: section conformance, coherence C1-C8, issues by priority with rule IDs
Flags roadmap paragraph, results in Method, interpretation in Results, H2 not evaluated, table without proposal row, missing contributions and future work

evals.prompt: Analise estes três artigos para a minha seção de trabalhos relacionados. Minha proposta é um sistema de recomendação explicável para e-commerce.
expectations: One card per paper with the 4 parts: overview, claimed contributions, relationship, gaps
Separates limitations admitted by the authors from limitations identified in the analysis
Comparative table with the proposal as the last row and a legend
Does not add papers that were not provided

evals.prompt: Make a related work comparison table for my paper on code review automation with LLMs.
expectations: Asks for the papers or offers to search and verify them; never fabricates references
Asks for the proposal summary if not given

evals.prompt: Classifique a metodologia da minha pesquisa: fiz um experimento controlado comparando dois algoritmos em 5 datasets públicos e medi tempo e acurácia.
expectations: Classifies all six dimensions (area, nature, objectives, procedures, object, approach) with justification
Delivers the classification as continuous prose
Points out that explanatory/experimental work needs hypotheses

evals.prompt: Help me plan the experiment for my user study comparing two IDE plugins with 20 developers.
expectations: Covers context, H0/H1, independent/dependent/control variables, units, design, instrumentation
Covers the four threat types with mitigations
Mentions ethics approval and consent for human participants

evals.prompt: Como fica a citação de um artigo com quatro autores em ABNT no texto e na lista de referências?
expectations: Uses NBR 10520:2023 mixed-case in-text citation (Silva et al., 2024)
Mentions NBR 6023 edition choice (2025 vs 2018) depending on the institution
Uses fictitious placeholder data, not a fabricated real reference
